#version 330
in vec2 v_uv; uniform sampler2D u_tex; out vec4 frag;
uniform vec4 u_uv_rect;
uniform vec2 u_tex_size;
uniform vec2 u_sharp_scale;
uniform int  u_sharp;
uniform int   u_scanline;
uniform float u_scanline_strength;
uniform float u_scanline_lines;
uniform float u_scanline_scale;
vec4 bicubic(vec2 uv){
  vec2 sp = uv * u_tex_size;
  vec2 t1 = floor(sp - 0.5) + 0.5;
  vec2 f  = sp - t1;
  vec2 w0 = f * (-0.5 + f * (1.0 - 0.5 * f));
  vec2 w1 = 1.0 + f * f * (-2.5 + 1.5 * f);
  vec2 w2 = f * (0.5 + f * (2.0 - 1.5 * f));
  vec2 w3 = f * f * (-0.5 + 0.5 * f);
  vec2 w12 = w1 + w2;
  vec2 t0 = (t1 - 1.0) / u_tex_size;
  vec2 t3 = (t1 + 2.0) / u_tex_size;
  vec2 t12 = (t1 + w2 / w12) / u_tex_size;
  vec4 r = vec4(0.0);
  r += texture(u_tex, vec2(t0.x , t0.y )) * (w0.x  * w0.y );
  r += texture(u_tex, vec2(t12.x, t0.y )) * (w12.x * w0.y );
  r += texture(u_tex, vec2(t3.x , t0.y )) * (w3.x  * w0.y );
  r += texture(u_tex, vec2(t0.x , t12.y)) * (w0.x  * w12.y);
  r += texture(u_tex, vec2(t12.x, t12.y)) * (w12.x * w12.y);
  r += texture(u_tex, vec2(t3.x , t12.y)) * (w3.x  * w12.y);
  r += texture(u_tex, vec2(t0.x , t3.y )) * (w0.x  * w3.y );
  r += texture(u_tex, vec2(t12.x, t3.y )) * (w12.x * w3.y );
  r += texture(u_tex, vec2(t3.x , t3.y )) * (w3.x  * w3.y );
  return r;
vec3 psx_scanline(vec3 rgb, float vy){
  if (u_scanline == 0) return rgb;
  float gate = clamp(u_scanline_scale - 1.0, 0.0, 1.0);
  if (gate <= 0.0) return rgb;
  float p    = fract(vy * u_scanline_lines);
  float beam = sin(3.14159265 * p);
  float mult = 1.0 - (u_scanline_strength * gate) * (1.0 - beam);
  return rgb * mult;
void main(){
  vec2 uv = v_uv;
  vec4 c;
  if (u_sharp == 2) { c = bicubic(uv); }
  else {
    if (u_sharp == 1) {
      vec2 scale = max(u_sharp_scale, vec2(1.0));
      vec2 texel = uv * u_tex_size;
      vec2 tf    = floor(texel);
      vec2 cd    = (texel - tf) - 0.5;
      vec2 band  = 0.5 - 0.5 / scale;
      vec2 f     = (cd - clamp(cd, -band, band)) * scale + 0.5;
      uv = (tf + f) / u_tex_size;
      vec2 lo = min(u_uv_rect.xy, u_uv_rect.zw);
      vec2 hi = max(u_uv_rect.xy, u_uv_rect.zw);
      uv = clamp(uv, lo, hi);
    }
    c = texture(u_tex, uv);
  c.rgb = psx_scanline(c.rgb, v_uv.y);
  frag = c;

#version 330
layout(location=0) in vec2 a_pos;
layout(location=1) in vec4 a_col;
uniform float u_shift;
uniform float u_xoff;   /* native-wide x translation (px); 0 canonical */
uniform float u_xhalf;  /* x clip half-extent (px); 512 canonical */
uniform float u_xscale; /* native-wide 2D-backdrop x-stretch; 1 canonical */
uniform float u_xcenter;/* stretch centre in VRAM px; 0 canonical */
noperspective out vec4 v_col;
void main(){ v_col = a_col;
  float xb = a_pos.x;
  if (u_xscale < 0.0) {
    float s = -u_xscale; float h = u_xhalf / s;
    float l = u_xcenter - h, r = u_xcenter + h;
    if (xb < l) xb = l + (xb-l)*s; else if (xb > r) xb = r + (xb-r)*s;
  } else xb = (xb - u_xcenter)*u_xscale + u_xcenter;
  gl_Position = vec4((xb+u_shift+u_xoff)/u_xhalf - 1.0, (a_pos.y+u_shift)/256.0 - 1.0, 0.0, 1.0); }
#version 330
noperspective in vec2 v_uv; noperspective in vec4 v_col;
smooth in vec2 v_uv_p; flat in int v_persp;
out vec4 frag; out vec4 blend_factor;
flat in ivec2 v_tpage;   /* texture page base, VRAM px */
flat in ivec2 v_clut;    /* CLUT base, VRAM px */
flat in int v_depth;     /* 0=4bit 1=8bit 2=15bit */
flat in int v_raw;       /* 1 = no color modulation */

uniform usampler2D u_vram;
uniform int u_semipass;  /* 0=all texels, 1=STP=0 only, 2=STP=1 only */
uniform int u_semimode;  /* PS1 blend mode; drives dual-source factors */
uniform ivec4 u_twin;    /* texture window: mask_x, mask_y, off_x, off_y */
uniform int u_maskset;   /* GP0(E6h) set-mask: OR bit15 into output */

int vram_at(int x, int y){
  return int(texelFetch(u_vram, ivec2(x & 1023, y & 511), 0).r);
int fetch_texel(int u, int v){
  u &= 255; v &= 255;
  if ((u_twin.x | u_twin.y) != 0) {
    u = (u & ~(u_twin.x * 8)) | ((u_twin.z & u_twin.x) * 8);
    v = (v & ~(u_twin.y * 8)) | ((u_twin.w & u_twin.y) * 8);
  } else {
    u = clamp(u, v_limits.x, v_limits.z);
    v = clamp(v, v_limits.y, v_limits.w);
  if (v_depth == 0) {
    int px = vram_at(v_tpage.x + (u >> 2), v_tpage.y + v);
    return vram_at(v_clut.x + ((px >> ((u & 3) * 4)) & 0xF), v_clut.y);
  } else if (v_depth == 1) {
    int px = vram_at(v_tpage.x + (u >> 1), v_tpage.y + v);
    return vram_at(v_clut.x + ((px >> ((u & 1) * 8)) & 0xFF), v_clut.y);
  return vram_at(v_tpage.x + u, v_tpage.y + v);
vec3 col5(int raw){
  return vec3(float(raw & 31), float((raw >> 5) & 31), float((raw >> 10) & 31)) / 31.0;
void main(){
  int stp; vec3 rgb;
  /* v_persp is 0 for every prim unless [video] perspective_texturing is on
   * AND this prim's packet carried full GTE projection provenance, so the
   * default is the PS1's affine (noperspective) mapping. */
  vec2 uv = (v_persp != 0) ? v_uv_p : v_uv;
  if (u_filter == 0) {
    int raw = fetch_texel(int(floor(uv.x)), int(floor(uv.y)));
    if (raw == 0) discard;
    rgb = col5(raw);
    stp = (raw >> 15) & 1;
  } else {
    /* Bilinear, Beetle-PSX formulation: the NEAREST texel is the base
     * (cutout + STP authority), the neighbours lie toward the sub-texel
     * offset and clamp to u_limits, and each texel's weight is gated by
     * its opacity with the colour renormalised 
 so prim edges and
     * cutout borders keep their colour instead of dissolving into the
     * transparent (black) neighbour and discarding whole edge columns.
     * Recenter from PS1 top-left point sampling to the bilinear footprint. */
    uv += vec2(u_shift);
    int iu = int(floor(uv.x)), iv = int(floor(uv.y));
    float fx = uv.x - float(iu) - 0.5, fy = uv.y - float(iv) - 0.5;
    int sx = fx < 0.0 ? -1 : 1, sy = fy < 0.0 ? -1 : 1;
    fx = abs(fx); fy = abs(fy);
    int c00 = fetch_texel(iu, iv);
    if (c00 == 0) discard;
    int c10 = fetch_texel(iu + sx, iv);
    int c01 = fetch_texel(iu, iv + sy);
    int c11 = fetch_texel(iu + sx, iv + sy);
    float w00 = (c00 == 0 ? 0.0 : 1.0) * (1.0 - fx) * (1.0 - fy);
    float w10 = (c10 == 0 ? 0.0 : 1.0) * fx * (1.0 - fy);
    float w01 = (c01 == 0 ? 0.0 : 1.0) * (1.0 - fx) * fy;
    float w11 = (c11 == 0 ? 0.0 : 1.0) * fx * fy;
    float opac = w00 + w10 + w01 + w11;
    rgb = (col5(c00)*w00 + col5(c10)*w10 + col5(c01)*w01 + col5(c11)*w11) / opac;
    float stpf = (float((c00 >> 15) & 1) * w00 + float((c10 >> 15) & 1) * w10
                + float((c01 >> 15) & 1) * w01 + float((c11 >> 15) & 1) * w11) / opac;
    stp = stpf >= 0.5 ? 1 : 0;
  if (u_semipass == 1 && stp == 1) discard;
  if (u_semipass == 2 && stp == 0) discard;
  if (v_raw == 0) rgb = clamp(rgb * v_col.rgb * 2.0, 0.0, 1.0);
  float dst_factor = 0.0;
  if (u_semimode == 4 && v_semi != 0 && stp != 0) {
    dst_factor = v_semi == 1 ? 0.5 : 1.0;
    if (v_semi == 1) rgb *= 0.5; else if (v_semi == 4) rgb *= 0.25;
  frag = vec4(rgb, (stp == 1 || u_maskset == 1) ? 1.0 : 0.0);
  blend_factor = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, dst_factor);
#version 330
layout(location=0) in vec2 a_pos;
layout(location=1) in vec2 a_uv;
layout(location=2) in vec4 a_col;
layout(location=3) in vec2 a_tpage;
layout(location=4) in vec2 a_clut;
layout(location=5) in float a_depth;
layout(location=6) in float a_raw;

uniform float u_shift;
uniform float u_xoff;   /* native-wide x translation (px); 0 canonical */
uniform float u_xhalf;  /* x clip half-extent (px); 512 canonical */
uniform float u_xscale; /* native-wide 2D-backdrop x-stretch; 1 canonical */
uniform float u_xcenter;/* stretch centre in VRAM px; 0 canonical */
noperspective out vec2 v_uv; noperspective out vec4 v_col;
smooth out vec2 v_uv_p;  /* perspective-correct UV (used when v_persp!=0) */
flat out int v_persp;
flat out ivec2 v_tpage; flat out ivec2 v_clut; flat out int v_depth;
flat out int v_raw; flat out ivec4 v_limits; flat out int v_semi;
void main(){ v_uv = a_uv; v_uv_p = a_uv; v_col = a_col;
  v_persp = (a_q > 0.0) ? 1 : 0;
  v_tpage = ivec2(a_tpage + 0.5); v_clut = ivec2(a_clut + 0.5);
  v_depth = int(a_depth + 0.5); v_raw = int(a_raw + 0.5);
  v_semi = int(a_semi + 0.5);
  v_limits = ivec4(floor(a_limits + 0.5));
  /* u_shift: align GL's center-sample grid with the PS1 integer grid (see
   * GEO_VS) so interpolated uv at a fragment equals the PS1 DDA value. */
  float xb = a_pos.x;
  if (u_xscale < 0.0) {
    float s = -u_xscale; float h = u_xhalf / s;
    float l = u_xcenter - h, r = u_xcenter + h;
    if (xb < l) xb = l + (xb-l)*s; else if (xb > r) xb = r + (xb-r)*s;
  } else xb = (xb - u_xcenter)*u_xscale + u_xcenter;
  /* Perspective-correct UV rides the standard w divide: emit clip coords
   * pre-multiplied by w = 1/q so the post-divide NDC is unchanged while
   * the rasterizer interpolates the smooth varying hyperbolically. With
   * a_q == 0 (feature off) w is exactly 1.0 and this is the old expression. */
  float w = (a_q > 0.0) ? (1.0 / a_q) : 1.0;
  vec2 ndc = vec2((xb+u_shift+u_xoff)/u_xhalf - 1.0, (a_pos.y+u_shift)/256.0 - 1.0);
  gl_Position = vec4(ndc * w, 0.0, w); }

##lobby_public_ip
Direct IP over the internet needs UDP port forwarding on your router.
1. On your router, forward the Port shown above (UDP) from the Public IP Address to this PC's LAN IP Address.
2. Remote friends Join Direct with your Public IP and that Port.
3. Players on your local network can keep using the LAN IP Address.
Router menus differ (Port Forwarding, Virtual Server, or NAT). Leave the lobby open while they connect.

Lobby Settings
Disable Rollback
Off (default): invent missing remote inputs and correct with rollback episodes (match_caps.rollback=1).
On: force delay-sync for the match. Manual Input Prediction is locked out; only Input Delay applies.
Manual Input Delay
(frames)
##manual_input_delay
Off (default): at match start the host sets input delay from the highest peer latency in the lobby.
On: use the frame value to the right for every player.
##lobby_input_delay
?##input_delay_help
Committed input delay D (send lead / buffer).
With rollback (Disable Rollback off), auto D from max peer RTT (
60 WAN-aware):
50 ms 
 3, 50
 4, 80
  120
 7, then steps up (floor 3).
Forced TURN floors at 6 (lobby RTT underestimates the relay path).
With delay-sync (Disable Rollback on), auto D covers one-way RTT at 60 Hz plus a 3-frame jitter pad:
  D = ceil(RTT_ms / 33.3) + 3  (min 3, max 20)
Too low stalls when packets arrive late. Too high adds input lag for everyone.
Manual Input Prediction
##manual_input_prediction
Rollback invent runway P. Off (default): host sets P from peer RTT at match start. On: use the frame value to the right.
Locked when Disable Rollback is on (delay-sync).
##lobby_input_prediction
?##input_prediction_help
How far ahead of the remote tip a peer may invent hold-last inputs before stalling (phase_lock).
Tip: prediction should be 4 + delay.
Auto (checkbox off): P = 4 + D (clamped 6..16).
Manual: keep the same relationship unless you are deliberately tuning.
Outside this window the fast peer freezes until the buffer refills; sustained freezes raise delay.
Host-enforced DualShock sticks on multitap tap seats for this match (match_caps.multitap_analog). Off = faithful digital taps. Peers apply the host setting at launch.

- all discs are required.
psxrecomp games require a .cue + .bin dump of the disc, or an official re-release image (.car, e.g. from the Steam Special Edition).
A single-track .bin or .iso cannot be converted to multitrack. Redump-style dumps are the usual source; you can make your own from the original disc with redumper (https://github.com/superg/redumper).
Always point Generate at the .cue when one exists.

CREDITS
Switch BIOS?
This retail BIOS is not compiled into the current build yet. Generate & rebuild will emit its BIOS C and rebuild the game binary with your current disc and toolchain. OpenBIOS switches never need this 
 use Use OpenBIOS instead.
Selected:
Selected: OpenBIOS
BIOS not ready to Play
The selected retail BIOS is not compiled into this build. Generate & rebuild with it (same disc and toolchain), switch to OpenBIOS to Play without rebuilding, or cancel and keep the current selection.
Current selection:
Current selection: OpenBIOS
Optimize FMV Playback?
This will rebuild an instrumented binary, run the intro FMV in PGO training mode (video window open 
 do not close or interact with it), then rebuild the game with those profiles. Existing generated C is reused; the setup wizard is not run.
Expect several minutes. Keep this launcher open until training finishes, then the optimized binary relaunches.
Each peer may run this independently for rollback netplay. Digests must still match.
Start training
Apply FMV Timing Opt?
This regenerates game C from game.toml (including load_charge_batch for VLC leaves), then rebuilds. It does not disable load-delay and does not run PGO training.
Expect a few minutes for generate + rebuild. The launcher will relaunch the new binary when done.
Both peers need the same load_charge_batch setting for matching rollback digests.
Skip the launcher on boot?
The launcher will no longer appear - the game boots straight in. Run with "--launcher" or set "SkipLauncher = 0" in config.ini to bring it back.
Skip on Boot

No LAN/Direct IP lobby at that address.
Join a LAN/Direct IP lobby by IP (or pick a LAN row from the lobby list after Refresh 
 hosts announce via UDP broadcast). The host must create with LAN/Direct IP Only checked and keep the waiting room open. Use their LAN IP on the same network, or their Public IP with UDP port-forwarded to the host PC. Online (MotK) lobbies: join from the server list instead.

Restore default settings?
This resets display, audio, controller, and launcher choices. Your selected ROM, SRAM, and save states are not changed.

Renderer

supersampling
Internal-resolution SSAA.
Offline: full software/GL supersampling.

Antialiasing
antialiasing
FMV filtering
fmv_filter
Nearest
Antialiasing is off, so video is presented with hard pixels.
Perspective textures
##persptex
Interpolates textures with perspective, which stops large floors and walls from warping as the camera moves.
Applied only to polygons the runtime can prove came from the 3D pipeline, so 2D art and menus are left alone.
Screen model
Frame interpolation
Presentation target
VSync
On: the swap waits for the panel 
 no tearing.
Off: swap immediately 
 lowest display latency, may tear.
Adaptive: vsync while the game keeps up, immediate when it drops below the refresh rate.
The runtime still paces frames to the console's own rate either way, so Off does not run the game fast.
Skip FMVs
##skipfmv
Rewind
##rewind_enabled
Rewind the last few seconds of play (F8, or Select+R3).
Off by default: it keeps whole-machine snapshots in memory,
which costs hundreds of MB and a capture every few frames.
Turning it off frees that immediately.
Rewind buffer
How many local rewind snapshots to keep (50 / 100 / 150 / 200).
Each one is a few MB of machine state.
Takes effect on the next launch.
Rewind interval
Frames between rewind snapshots (1 / 4 / 8 / 12 / 15).
FMV still densifies toward 4 when this is sparser.
Takes effect on the next launch.

Font scale
Note that the default embedded font is NOT meant to be scaled.
Font are currently rendered into bitmaps at a given size at the time of building the atlas. You may oversample them to get some flexibility with scaling. You can also render at multiple sizes and select which one to use at runtime.
(Glimmer of hope: the atlas system will be rewritten in the future to make scaling more flexible.)

Dear ImGui ID Stack Tool
0x%08X
Hover an item with the mouse to display elements of the ID Stack leading to the item's final ID.
Each level of the stack correspond to a PushID() call.
All levels of the stack are hashed together to make the final ID of a widget (ID displayed at the bottom level of the stack).
Read FAQ entry about the ID stack for details.
